notes: `כָּזֹאת` → *in like manner* is retained as one fused unit headed on `זֹאת`: neither *like* nor *manner* stands alone as English, so no morpheme owns a part (rule 30). The competing reading gives *like* to the preposition.
`מִשָּׁם` → *thence* and `כַּאֲשֶׁר` → *as* are fused under rules 30 and 23; the bare `פְּנוּאֵל` takes the supplied directional *to* under rule 33.
